question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched position within the Chinese Communist Party, reinforced by ongoing purges of military and party officials that have eliminated potential rivals, underpins the 95.5% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. With no designated successor and expectations that he will pursue a fourth term at the 21st Party Congress later that year, recent analyses highlight the absence of organized internal opposition or events capable of forcing a leadership change. This skin-in-the-game pricing reflects the structural barriers in China's one-party system, where Xi has centralized authority since removing presidential term limits. Realistic shifts could still arise from abrupt health developments, unforeseen elite fractures, or major policy crises that erode loyalty, though such outcomes remain low-probability based on current evidence.
